params.description: Parent collection for the knowledge domain; autogenerated and not editable.

params.name: generative_exchange_id
params.description: Unique ID of the generative exchange item; if supplied, overrides the collection ID as a filter item; default is no entry.

params.name: status
params.description: Unique ID of the generative exchange item; if supplied, overrides the collection ID as a filter item; default is no entry.

params.name: creator_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the user who provided feedback; output field, automatically populated.

params.name: rank
params.description: Rank value given by the user; valid responses are 1 (negative) and 5 (positive).

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum page size is 100; default is 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: For multiple pages; must be specified in each request for two pages per sheet.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order for multi page requests; valid options are rank, rank desc, create_time, create_time desc.
